description: A salary negotiated in one year buys substantially less by the next without anything happening. That is the precondition for the planning collapse in PSY-003.
energy_note: Working harder, and having less, reliably.

aspect: Saving in naira is a choice to lose money
description: Households convert to goods, dollars or property where they can. The resulting absence of formal savings is then read abroad as financial illiteracy.
energy_note: Punished for not saving in a currency that eats itself.

aspect: Which makes emigration the dominant financial strategy
description: When domestic accumulation does not work, converting labour into foreign currency becomes the only reliable plan - which is japa, stated as arithmetic rather than aspiration.

aspect: SCENARIO - the savings for the shop
description: She saved NGN 2.1 million over four years for a shop front in Surulere. By the time she had it, the same shop front cost NGN 5.4 million. She had not spent a naira of it and had lost most of it.
energy_note: Four years of discipline, and the goalposts moved further than she walked.
